profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Cox Automotive Inc.
profile.summary:
Raul has helped make thousands of phones ring with Call-Em-All, categorized every automobile with Cox Automotive, and squashed a few bugs. He works primarily with JavaScript but isn't afraid to get his hands dirty with Python or C#. Raul loves to find new and creative ways to use technology to build amazing experiences. Raul believes that you can use the magic of software and technology to improve both your work and personal life. 

When Raul's not working his magic with code, he's playing with his two children or watching a movie.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
Cox Automotive provides technology solutions for the entirety of a vehicle's life cycle. The Data Solution team is the central data repository for brands such as Autotrader.com, Kelly Blue Book, and Manheim.

Worked with a team to create and manage vehicle description data used by various internal customers.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Call-Em-All believes that everyone has something important to say. Call-Em-All provides an automated messaging service to send your alerts, notifications and reminders to your whole group via phone and text message.

Owned multiple C# applications that manage the state of outgoing phone calls and text messages. Maintained and added unit tests when new requirements arrived. Leveraged Amazon queuing service (SQS) to allow applications to scale horizontally across the cloud.

Collaborated with a cross department team to introduce Net Promoter Score (NPS) to Call-Em-All. Managed C# application to automate sending out surveys and retrieve data when customers responded. Worked with the customer service team to streamline a process to follow up with customers who reported any issues. Analyzed customer responses and presented data to the NPS team with the goal of determining what we can do to improve customer satisfaction.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
DealerTrack Interactive, which acquired ClickMotive, provides web and technology solutions for the automotive industry primarily working with dealerships.  Clients range from independent dealerships to major manufacturers.

Developed a system to manage and automatically update clients’ Google paid search campaigns based on customer meta data and vehicle inventory.  Utilized RavenDB to store operations sent via the Google AdWords Api to update 100+ accounts.

Led project to update in house data processing system to address changes in the vendor’s Api.  Data included vehicle information and promotional material from the manufacturer to appear on all sites in preparation for launching new models.

Worked in an agile environment with the core development team on dealer websites and internal tools.  Updated and maintained various HTML templates for multiple customers. Worked with development team to create a system to provide Facebook pages for dealerships.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
ApexCCTV is a nationally recognized leader in video/audio surveillance and access control solutions. ApexCCTV‘s core business relies heavily on online sales and search engine optimization. 

Led the creation of an internal customer relationship management system. Initiated migration of internal Windows Forms application to a single MVC web application. Maintained and customized an off the shelf shopping cart based on Asp.Net Web Forms. Optimized production of regional marketing campaigns using Python and Google Docs

positions.title: System Engineer
positions.description:
ProAce provides custom software applications and solutions to businesses across varying domains. 

Developed data collection and reporting tools for a worldwide consulting firm. Interacted with clients to gather and clarify requirements for projects. Provided geolocation functionality for a Facebook Application

positions.title: Intern - Software Developer
positions.description:
Mary Kay is a direct sales cosmetic company that uses Microsoft technologies.

Converted an existing Asp.Net Web Forms application from 1.0 to 2.0.  Given ownership of internal award tracking system . Provided technical and development support for marketing websites

educations.schoolName: The University of Texas at Dallas

projects.title: 2016 Launch Hackathon - Rewind.Site
projects.description:
Raul participated in the 2016 Launch Hackathon held in San Francisco, California. Each team has 48 hours to create a project from scratch and present it to a team of judges. Over 250 teams from all over the world participated. Learn more at http://devpost.com/software/rewind-site

Rewind.Site attempts to capture the fun of watching live tweets, on your own schedule. The goal is to capture the second screen experience when content is watched streaming or on-demand.

projects.title: Kninect
projects.description: Demo app that uses the Kinect to reproduce visual effects from the Nine Inch Nail’s Lights In the Sky Tour.
